==Description==
The '''Mummy''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appeared in [[Nightmare Carnival]] as a part of the [[Halloween 2019 Event]]. It was the first enemy that appeared in the event, with average health and speed. The '''Mummy''' could be spawned by the [[Jack O' Bot]] and [[Reaper (Nightmare Carnival)|Reaper]].

==Appearance==
The '''Mummy''' was wrapped around with bandages, which covered most of its body, exposing only some of its arms and its head. Its torso and legs were white. It had green skin and was faceless.

==Strategy==
*[[Soldier]]s or [[Paintballer]]s can help clear through '''Mummies''' quite easily.
*As they spawn in hordes, splash damage towers such as the [[Demoman]] and [[Rocketeer]] can be very useful.
*[[Minigunner]]s can easily clear out hordes of '''Mummies'''. However, you will need to save up cash in order to afford them early on.
*If you already have the [[Slasher|Shredder]], it can be helpful in defeating it.

==Trivia==
*The '''Mummy's''' appearance was based on the tradition in wrapping dead humans in papyrus, commonly associated to Ancient Egypt. Nowadays, it is used as a Halloween costume by wrapping someone in toilet paper.
